q: What is your career goals for next years?
a: My career goal for the next years is to build a successful career in the aviation sector. I aim to become a senior cabin crew member at Emirates Airlines. I want to deepen my knowledge of aviation, improve my communication and teamwork skills, and specialize in customer service and safety procedures. In the future, I also hope to take on more responsibilities, such as training new staff, and become a valuable contributor to the airline’s success.
